text:
Maya Chen: Morning — quick heads up. We're about to launch a pricing experiment that touches legacy 'Tier L' accounts. New price sheet v3 will A/B split legacy accounts into L1/L2 with different rounding/exemptions. Need finance + revops gating before we push. Main risks: accidentally charging overage invoices incorrectly / grandfathering not applied.

Liam O'Connor: can you paste the exact grandfathering mapping? which accounts get preserved?

Maya Chen: copying mapping below — it's a CSV we exported. Please confirm mapping and any edgecases.
```
account_id,old_tier,new_experiment_group,grandfather_until
acct_112233,Tier L,L1,2025-06-30
acct_445566,Tier L,L2,2025-12-31
acct_778899,Tier L,L2,2024-12-31
```

Sarah Patel: quick q — are vendor pass-throughs impacted? our vendor pricing sheet changed on 2025-01-08 and some SKUs moved.

Jorge Rivera: Need invoice preview for impacted accounts — can billing-bot run a dry invoice for the L1/L2 groups for last billing cycle? Also flag any credits.

billing-bot: dry-run invoices queued. Estimated runtime: ~8m. Output -> s3://redwood-billing/dryruns/2187654321-preview.csv

Elena (revops): tagging @finance-approvals — we need sign-off on grandfathering policy and the customer comms template. Draft here: https://docs.redwood/pricing/comm-template

Liam O'Connor: looks good to me but need legal on message for accounts with monthly commitments.

Maya Chen: OK — legal pinged. Also FYI: can we hold the rollout to 10% traffic and use canary route to avoid spikes? Plan: 10% day1, check invoices, 50% day3 if no regressions.

Sarah Patel: I can run reconciliation checks: token-level delta, invoice amounts, vendor pass-through alignment. Anything else?

Jorge Rivera: add 'metering window' edgecases — accounts billed on unusual cycle boundaries. We had one previous incident where prorations were misapplied. Please include proration simulation.

Elena (revops): approved the comms with edits. Also propose a 'grandfather audit' task force: Sarah, Jorge, Liam. Can you meet 30m after dry-run output?

Maya Chen: Meeting scheduled: 2187654350 (30m). Action items: 1) billing dry-run + discrepancies 2) vendor SKU mapping 3) legal language final 4) canary routing config. I'll follow up with push schedule after sign-offs.

billing-bot: dry-run complete. Summary: 27 accounts with grandfather flags, 3 invoices show proration mismatch, CSV -> s3://redwood-billing/dryruns/2187654321-results.csv

Sarah Patel: grabbing the CSV now. Initial check: two of the proration mismatches are due to month boundary bug we patched last week — they should be resolved in next run. One looks like legacy rounding rules not applied.

Liam O'Connor: re: rounding — old rule: round down to nearest dollar for Tier L credits. New rules changed that. We must ensure grandfathering keeps old rounding for accounts with 'grandfather_until' > today.

Maya Chen: Agreed. Can ops patch the billing pipeline to respect grandfathering rounding before we flip the canary? @eng-billing?

Jorge Rivera: I'll open an urgent PR to add conditional rounding flag; will request fast review.

Jorge Rivera: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/billing/pull/4721 — description: 'apply legacy rounding for grandfathered accounts'

Elena (revops): Once PR merges and new dry-run looks clean, I'm ok with 10% canary. Legal still needs to approve exact wording on comms — pinged.

Sarah Patel: after PR merges I'll run runtime dry-run and reconcile tokens + invoice amounts and post a short summary.

Maya Chen: Great. If all clear, push window tomorrow 02:00 UTC. If any blocker, we hold. :thumbsup:
